records.source_title: Corporate Profile - Kardex
records.excerpt: The Group employs around 2’900 people in over 30 countries. Kardex Holding AG has been listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1989.
records.does_not_establish: Headcount and listing say nothing about how many customers are small businesses or individuals.

records.source_title: Corporate Profile - Kardex
records.excerpt: Kardex provides an intelligent entry into automation with its dynamic storage and retrieval systems, offers integrated material handling systems, small parts storage systems including multi-shuttle technology, and automated high-bay warehouses.
records.does_not_establish: It lists industrial product families and does not show any product sized or priced for households or very small shops.

records.source_title: Kardex Holding AG: Financial Results 2025 (ad hoc release, 12 March 2026)
records.excerpt: Net revenues amounted to EUR 850.4 million, a 7.5% increase year-on-year. New Business contributed EUR 625.4 million or 73.5%, while LCS generated EUR 225.0 million or 26.5%.
records.does_not_establish: It gives no split of revenue by customer size, so the share coming from small buyers is not public here.

records.source_title: Kardex Investor Handbook, Version 7.2 - March 2026
records.excerpt: After this first level of automation with costs starting from €80k, Kardex accompanies its customers on their growth and automation journey, offering both stand-alone Subsystems and Integrated Standard Systems through its Kardex Mlog, Rocket Solution and Kardex AS Solutions business units.
records.does_not_establish: The starting cost is the company's own round figure and does not show what share of buyers pay near it or who they are.

records.source_title: Kardex Investor Handbook, Version 7.2 - March 2026
records.excerpt: Kardex Remstar has subsidiaries throughout Europe, Middle East/Africa, Asia-Pacific and the US. For Kardex Remstar, the combination of local presence with a global sales and service organization has become a crucial differentiator in terms of securing and gaining market share.
records.does_not_establish: It describes a subsidiary-based sales and service organisation; it does not say what share of sales goes through dealers, nor that any channel reaches consumers or retail shoppers.

records.source_title: Kardex Investor Handbook, Version 7.2 - March 2026
records.excerpt: Kardex Remstar customers can be found in a broad range of industries, from highly industrialized through to office environments.
records.does_not_establish: Industry breadth does not show customer size; office environments here are businesses and public bodies, not households.

records.source_title: Kardex Investor Handbook, Version 7.2 - March 2026
records.excerpt: With over 140’000 installed Kardex Remstar machines and over 1’000 Kardex Mlog warehouse systems, the Group has a broad existing customer base that counts on first-class after-sales services.
records.does_not_establish: A count of installed machines does not tell how many distinct customers there are or how small the smallest are.

records.source_title: Vertical Lift Module Pricing Guide: Calculating the Cost of Your VLM - Kardex blog
records.excerpt: The baseline price for a standard Vertical Lift Module is around $95,000. As a baseline, you can buget between $6,000 - $8,000 per vertical foot, with more advanced or integrated systems costing more.
records.does_not_establish: A list-level baseline is not a transaction price, and it says nothing about what a much smaller unit could cost to build.

records.source_title: Vertical Lift Module Pricing Guide: Calculating the Cost of Your VLM - Kardex blog
records.excerpt: Kardex only permits factory-trained, certified personnel to install and service our equipment.
records.does_not_establish: It describes the current service rule, not whether a smaller, self-installed product would be technically or legally possible.

records.source_title: The Benefits of Vertical Lift Modules for Small Warehouses - Kardex blog
records.excerpt: Yet among companies that are still largely manual, 38% told us they think their facility is simply “too small” for automation, even though half say they plan to integrate their systems in the future.
records.population: Warehouse operators surveyed by Kardex with Modern Materials Handling and Peerless Research Group
records.does_not_establish: It covers warehouse businesses, not households or micro-businesses, and the survey size and method are not given here.

records.source_title: Kardex Pre-owned Units - Kardex
records.excerpt: Kardex pre-owned systems deliver the same space-saving, efficiency-boosting performance you'd expect from our solutions and at a fraction of the cost and lead time. Whether you're scaling up, replacing legacy equipment, or taking your first step into automated storage, a pre-owned Kardex system gets you there faster.
records.does_not_establish: It gives no prices or volumes, so how far pre-owned units reach smaller buyers is not shown.

records.source_title: Automotive Parts Management - Kardex
records.excerpt: Kardex automated storage systems bring speed, structure, and visibility to dealership parts departments. They condense storage footprints, increase on-hand inventory, and allow service operations to run more efficiently—resulting in faster repairs, higher throughput, and increased customer satisfaction.
records.does_not_establish: It shows a small-site business use case is marketed, not how many dealerships have bought or at what unit size.

records.source_title: Kardex Group - Wikipedia
records.excerpt: Kardex has been a significant name in business data storage since 1898, tracing back to the Rand Ledger Company.
records.does_not_establish: A brand history rooted in business record-keeping does not show that today's buyers or consumers recognise the name.

records.does_not_establish: One small-site distributor is not evidence of demand among households or very small workshops.
